steps.what: Define the outside reading assignment's specialist topic, learning purpose and selection constraints
inputs: current course outcomes and planned outside reading assignment

steps.what: Find actual specialized materials in the library catalogue and existing reference collection using the reading criteria
inputs: library-owned catalogue records and teacher's existing references
outputs: actual candidate records and source identifiers

steps.what: Read or inspect the actual candidate materials and select suitable specialist works for the outside reading assignment
inputs: actual candidate records and source identifiers
outputs: teacher-selected actual works with relevance and access decisions

steps.what: Capture and check the selected works' bibliographic metadata from their actual catalogue records or title pages
inputs: teacher-selected actual works with relevance and access decisions
actual catalogue metadata and title pages
outputs: checked draft citation records for the selected works

steps.what: Compile the bibliography in the required citation style and assignment order from the checked citation records
inputs: checked draft citation records for the selected works

steps.what: Verify every final entry against an actual work and access route and approve the final bibliography for the intended class
inputs: teacher-selected actual works with relevance and access decisions
outputs: approved reading bibliography release packet v1

steps.what: Post the exact approved bibliography to the specified class reading assignment
inputs: approved reading bibliography release packet v1

tasks.design: Configure catalogue filters and native metadata import and citation styles in the {OTHER} library catalogue and reference manager. The teacher selects actual works, verifies imported records and approves the finished bibliography and class destination before posting it to the {LMS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated metadata entry and citation formatting can consume time after the intellectual reading selection is made.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue exports and reference-manager styles can reuse actual source metadata without generating a title or citation.
tasks.still_hard: A correctly formatted source may be unsuitable, inaccessible or the wrong edition for the assignment.
tasks.human_edge: Select works that support the particular artistic or critical learning purpose and check their actual content.

ambition.what: Prepare an accessible introductory reading pathway for students entering the specialist subject without its usual background.

reach.task: Check editions and access routes for specialist reading lists
reach.learn: Catalogue identifiers, edition distinctions and access metadata.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for library metadata and class-assignment access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: library catalogue exports and reference managers can import actual bibliographic metadata and render selected records in citation styles.

assumptions: Boundary includes topic definition, finding and selecting actual works, citation capture, bibliography compilation and class posting. Reading and suitability decisions remain fully human.

Library records supply catalogue id, creator, title, work type, edition, date and access reference where available. s4 retains six hours for import checks, missing-field entry and title-page comparison. No model-generated reference or free citation verification is assumed.

OTHER covers the library catalogue and reference manager. Native filters, metadata import and styles first. A missing or unresolved work stays out until manually verified; different art materials may require different metadata fields.

Shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. Existing search runtime earns no saving. The short class-posting action is retained; no same-system save or routine upload is banked as a saving.
Approval binds exact entries and the intended class destination; any changed work, edition or access reference requires renewed review.
unknowns: Existing reference-manager and catalogue export use
Availability of specialist materials and accessible editions
research_questions: Can every rendered entry be matched to an actual inspected work and edition?
Does import preserve the necessary metadata for scores, scripts or visual-art materials?

already_counted.description: Check imported citation metadata and fill missing source fields
Check style rendering and list ordering

incremental.description: Maintain catalogue-import mappings and course citation styles

approvals.approved_version: approved reading bibliography release packet v1 including exact entries and class destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 27 minus 1 upkeep gives 26. High allows six additional hours resolving specialist metadata and edition exceptions; low applies where native imports and styles already cover the work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide professional arts consulting to government or industry

steps.what: Clarify the government or industry client's consulting question, desired outcome and constraints
outputs: actual clarified consulting purpose and constraints

steps.what: Review the supplied client materials and relevant existing specialist references for the consulting question
inputs: actual clarified consulting purpose and constraints
client-supplied versioned materials and permitted use
outputs: checked consulting evidence and unanswered questions

steps.what: Develop and write the professional consulting advice using arts expertise and the actual client constraints
inputs: checked consulting evidence and unanswered questions
actual clarified consulting purpose and constraints

steps.what: Discuss the advice with the client and clarify practical implications and remaining questions
Complete the written consulting deliverable with actual clarifications, source references and exact client recipient
outputs: complete final consulting deliverable and client delivery details

steps.what: Verify the completed advice, limitations and recipient and approve the exact final client deliverable
inputs: complete final consulting deliverable and client delivery details

steps.what: Send the approved consulting deliverable to the exact government or industry client recipient
Save the exact approved consulting deliverable in its existing internal engagement record

tasks.design: Configure an engagement reference view and deliverable layout in the {DOCS}, reusing known client and source metadata and the teacher's already written advice. The teacher develops the professional judgement and captures actual client clarifications before approving the final deliverable and its separate {EMAIL} send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current client references and formatting a written deliverable can add effort around professional judgement and discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version filters and fixed report sections can reuse existing text and metadata without generating specialist advice.
tasks.still_hard: Client context, artistic quality and the consequences of a recommendation need professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the institution's or client's real purpose and challenge a superficially attractive recommendation.

ambition.what: No new consulting service or decision right is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for permitted client-material access and confidentiality review

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document systems can filter versioned client references and reuse approved layout blocks and existing authored text.

assumptions: Boundary covers clarifying the brief, evidence review, developing advice, client discussion, a written deliverable, send and stored issued version. This scenario assumes written advice is part of the actual consulting engagement rather than excluding it as conversation-only work.

Client owners supply material id, version and permitted use; the teacher chooses actual references. s3 counts all advice authorship, and s5 retains seven hours for substantive clarification capture, source attribution and final checking. No free transcript or structured client discussion output is assumed.
Native configuration first. s5 reuses existing advice and metadata in fixed sections; it does not generate new meaning. Any substantive changes after assembly are complete before s6 approval.
Shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. Same-system save and short external send remain fully retained. No client or third-party work is transferred for free.
unknowns: Actual written deliverables and reference-navigation effort
Existing engagement templates and client confidentiality constraints
research_questions: Does the layout reduce formatting while preserving exact advice and limitations?
Can every final recommendation be traced to authored reasoning and supplied evidence?

incremental.description: Maintain engagement metadata and deliverable layout blocks
